description: Records visitor click positions and scroll depth on chosen pages and posts, and shows them as a device-split heatmap overlay to administrators on the live page.

fields.label: Tracked pages and posts (checkbox list of all published pages AND posts; only ticked IDs are tracked)
Delete all heatmap data when the plugin is deleted

restEndpoints.description: Public collection endpoint for the front-end script. Validates and sanitizes post_id (absint), event_type (allow-list: click|scroll), x/y position or scroll depth (bounded numbers), and device (allow-list: desktop|tablet|mobile, derived from viewport width in the browser script). Accepts events only for post IDs ticked as tracked and ignores logged-in administrators. Inserts via $wpdb->insert / prepared SQL.
Aggregated click and scroll-depth results for one tracked post_id and device, for the admin overlay. permission_callback requires current_user_can('manage_options').

dataStorage: Custom table {$wpdb->prefix}hmtrk_events (id, post_id, event_type, pos_x, pos_y, scroll_depth, device, created_at) created on activation with dbDelta and versioned through the option hmtrk_db_version. Settings in options hmtrk_tracked_posts (array of post IDs) and hmtrk_delete_on_uninstall. No automatic expiry; data is removed only by the administrator's 'Clear heatmap data' button (admin-post handler, check_admin_referer + current_user_can('manage_options'), TRUNCATE/DELETE on the plugin table) or by uninstall.php when hmtrk_delete_on_uninstall is enabled (drops the table and deletes options). Front-end: a small tracking script enqueued only on tracked singular pages for visitors who are not administrators; an admin-bar node 'Heatmap' (admin_bar_menu, manage_options only, tracked pages only, front end) enqueues and toggles the overlay script/style, which fetches /hmtrk/v1/results with a wp_rest nonce and shows a desktop/tablet/mobile switch. No third-party services; all assets are local with versions.
securityRequirements: Direct-access ABSPATH guard in every PHP file; uninstall.php uses the WP_UNINSTALL_PLUGIN guard
Escape all output (esc_html, esc_attr, esc_url) at the echo, including post titles in the settings list
Settings save: wp_nonce_field + check_admin_referer + current_user_can('manage_options'); sanitize tracked IDs with absint and verify each is a published page/post
Clear heatmap data button: nonce (check_admin_referer) AND current_user_can('manage_options') before any delete

Public POST /hmtrk/v1/events is intentionally unauthenticated (anonymous visitors): strict allow-list validation via REST args (validate_callback + sanitize_callback), reject untracked post IDs, bound numeric values, cap payload size, never return stored data; not a nonce-protected route because page caching breaks anonymous nonces
GET /hmtrk/v1/results permission_callback checks current_user_can('manage_options'); REST cookie auth requires the X-WP-Nonce (wp_rest) header
Do not record events from logged-in users with manage_options (skip enqueue of tracker and reject server-side)
All SQL through $wpdb->prepare() with %s/%d placeholders; table name from $wpdb->prefix; dbDelta for schema
Overlay and admin-bar node only for manage_options; visitors never receive overlay assets or data
No eval, no @ suppression, no extract() on request data, no unserialize of untrusted input
Enqueue scripts/styles with wp_enqueue_script/wp_enqueue_style with version; pass REST URL and nonce via wp_localize_script/wp_add_inline_script; no remote resources
All user-facing strings internationalized with the literal text domain 'heatmap-tracker'
